sub_limits_waiting_notes: Grace period: 30 days (instalment monthly mode allowed). Source PDF is heavily CID-encoded; many specific fields could not be reliably extracted from the wordings text. Refer to brochure / CIS for detailed limits.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: In-patient hospitalisation expenses up to Sum Insured plus Guaranteed Cumulative Bonus (Gullak)
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Subject to Policy terms; AYUSH treatment is covered under qualified registered AYUSH Hospital/Day Care Centre definitions.

day_care_treatments.limit_text: Day care treatment under general/local anesthesia in Hospital/Day Care Centre in <24 hours

domiciliary_treatment.limit_text: Domiciliary hospitalisation where patient cannot be moved or no hospital room available

ayush_coverage.limit_text: AYUSH (Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) treatment at qualified AYUSH Hospital

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Guaranteed Cumulative Bonus (Gullak) — additional sum insured granted without associated premium increase

claim_process_summary: Cashless via network providers with pre-authorisation; reimbursement also available.
